final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  var mode_val = "fast"
  var level_val = "3"
  var other_keys: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = copy keys[i]
    let v = copy values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode_val = v
    else if k == "level"
      level_val = v
    else
      var seen = False
      for s in other_keys
        if s == k
          seen = True
          break
      if not seen
        other_keys.append(k)
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode_val)
  res.append(level_val)
  for ok in other_keys
    var final_val = ""
    for j in range(0, keys.len())
      if keys[j] == ok
        final_val = copy values[j]
    res.append(final_val)
  res
